shortDescription: This module creates/deletes Hitachi NAS virtual servers, and adds/deletes IP addresses

options.name: api_key
options.description: The REST API authentication key - the preferred authentication method.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the REST API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The URL to access the Hitachi NAS REST API.  This needs to include the protocol, address, port and API version.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the REST API.

options.name: data
options.description: Additional data to describe the virtual server. The I(name) parameter is required for both create and delete operations. The I(address_details) parameter can be used to add and remove multiple addresses from virtual servers The other parameters are only required for the create operation.

options.name: state
options.description: If I(state=present), ensure the existence of a virtual server, or ensure that IP addresses are assigned to a virtual server. If I(state=absent), ensure that specific IP addresses are not assigned to a virtual server, or that a virtual server is not present.
